title: Data and code for a critical review of column generation and branch-and-price acceleration

creators.name: Xinran Yang
creators.affiliation: School of Management and Engineering, Capital University of Economics and Business, China

description: Adjudicated records for 99 study families, 154 method variants, 505 source-located evidence items and 78 curated claims, with search and screening logs, version metadata, a codebook, source-data joins and portable code for regenerating review tables and figures. This is a bounded critical sample and does not reproduce source-paper solver experiments.
